notes: «جميعا عن غندر» : the three co-transmitters meet at one level, so one group, and the names written once after it form the shared tail
«قال ابن المثنى حدثنا محمد بن جعفر» : kept as written; «غندر» and «محمد بن جعفر» may be one man, but the text does not say so, so they are not merged (rule 9)
«قال عمران فلا أدري» is Imran's own doubt about the Prophet's repetition, not a new route
